<solar/>Solar Weapon Kills grant a Stack of Ember of Tempering for 8 seconds to you and allies within 15 meters.

<solar/>Ember of Tempering grants the following benefits:
• 20|40|60 Health stat at 1|2|3 Stacks
• 20 Airborne Effectiveness
• <solar/>Solar Weapon Kills spawn a <solar/>Firesprite
